summary: Round 2 review of T2-06. All three story checks pass: the gate test file (119 tests), make test (1175 tests) and make check. The round-1 fixes work as the author described. The manifest now lists every test of T2-01 to T2-03 plus 62 parametrized case lists. The record carries notes with the command, the pytest command and the commit. The committed G1 record is PARTIAL, because the T2-07 real-scene test is absent and the scope says so. The two rebuttals are acceptable. The one new observation is low severity.

checks.criterion: AC1: gate test file written; F1-F10 and invalid-data test ids listed in g1_required_tests.json
checks.evidence: jq keys of the manifest: conventions, fixtures, invalid_data, other, parametrized_cases, real_scene_check. The record shows F1-F10 groups and invalid_data for T2-01 to T2-03 (54, 56 and 39 tests). Ids carry per-story groups. I did not re-check that every test function is listed; the author's ast test (5a6a3c7) covers it and passes.

checks.criterion: AC2: record-g1 CLI reads junit, requires present and passed, never PASS when missing, failed, skipped or xfailed; parametrized cases complete
checks.evidence: The gate tests test_a_parametrized_test_missing_one_listed_case_is_incomplete_not_pass, test_a_duplicated_case_cannot_stand_in_for_a_missing_one and test_a_missing_required_test_gives_partial exist and pass. The committed record shows PARTIAL with the oracle test absent.

checks.criterion: AC3: status rules; scope states whether the real-scene check was included
checks.evidence: g1-record.json scope reads 'real-scene polsartools oracle check (T2-07, PRD 12): not included (1 of 1 absent from the junit report)'. Failure beats missing (test_a_failure_wins_over_missing_and_skipped_tests).

checks.criterion: AC4: output written to the given path; notes record the command and the commit; only fixtures/polarimetry/g1-record.json is written
checks.evidence: result.notes holds command, pytest_command, commit 42e9f24bac97e91e0b3780925b09a20957ec2bde and uncommitted_changes of [g1-record.json]. The notes tests (lines 903-952) pass. The diff touches only the 4 files in the story's list.

checks.criterion: AC5: a deliberately failing run gives FAIL with a nonzero exit; a tampered report with a required test missing is not PASS; the record validates as GateRecord
checks.evidence: The tests test_deliberately_failing_run_records_fail_and_its_exit_code_is_not_hidden, test_tampered_real_report_missing_a_required_test_is_not_pass and test_committed_record_follows_the_rules_from_its_own_result exist and pass. The record is built with GateRecord(...).model_dump_json. The consequence field is null on PASS.
ruff check passed, ruff format --check reported 15 files already formatted, mypy found no issues in 15 source files

findings.claim: evidence_path points to /tmp/terraluna-g1-r1/junit.xml, which is outside the repository, so a clean checkout cannot re-check the evidence file.
findings.evidence: The story allows a path outside the repo. The record keeps junit_sha256, the exact pytest command and the commit, so the author's rebuttal of claude-r1-2 holds. No action is needed.

findings.claim: The record names commit 42e9f24, not the commit that holds it (later commits change only test and record files). It also lists itself as uncommitted. This is inherent to a self-describing record and is checked by a gate test.
findings.evidence: notes.uncommitted_changes is [fixtures/polarimetry/g1-record.json]. The committed-record gate test passes.
